review_state: production rev 1 - M1, awaiting owner look review
purpose: Creature world ground cover (PROPOSED): a meadow grass tuft of bent, crossed cards cut out by the T_MeadowCards grass fans.

textures.name: T_MeadowCards
textures.packing: RGB the authored colour (CIE LCh greens at hue 139 or more; lilac, sky blue and cream flowers) in a 4 x 4 grid of 256 px cells: 0 grass meadow; 1 grass tall; 2 grass short; 3 grass sage; 4 sedge; 5 grass fine; 6 fern broad; 7 fern narrow; 8 lilac bells; 9 blue and cream stars; 10 cream umbels; 11 blue bells; 12 leaf rosette; 13 fern young; 14 clover; 15 grass and lilac stars; A the cut-out mask (alpha scissor at 0.5)

pivot: the clump's centre on the ground (Godot y = 0); card bottoms sink about 2 cm so the roots meet the ground on gentle relief
placement: walk-through cover: under 0.45 m, so it may stand anywhere inside the walls outside the nest's 8 m clearing (tests/test_creature_world_art.gd)

cards.material: M_MeadowCards (StandardMaterial3D: alpha scissor 0.5, back faces culled, COLOR_0 jitter)
cards.sides: two sheets back to back per card, opposite winding
cards.normals: each sheet's face normal plus 1.4 x world up, so both sides light like the ground

provenance: Authored procedurally by tools/blender/creature_flora.py (through make_creature_world.py); no external or generated meshes. The card atlas is painted in numpy (strokes in CIE LCh); no scans.
